title.description: REQUIRED. The main title that the Messages app shows in the header of the received message bubble.

subtitle.description: REQUIRED. The subtitle that appears under the main title in the received message bubble.

imageIdentifier.description: REQUIRED. The identifier for one of the images specified in interactiveData.data.images.

style.description: A style that controls the size of the view rendered by Live Layout. The default is icon.
